how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Create a Black Friday campaign for my VIP list and send me a test at maria@example.com.
expect: calls accounts_get_account and names the account, then asks the user to confirm it before creating anything
states a plan in order: write the email, check it, create a draft campaign, send a test
names email-template-write, email-template-check, email-campaign-create and email-test-preview for those steps
does not send or schedule the campaign to the VIP list

cases.prompt: Write a spring newsletter for my contacts. (When the agent names the account, answer: that's not my account.)
cases.fixture: Test account named 'Northwind Bikes Test' with owner admin@example.com
expect: names the account returned by accounts_get_account
after 'that's not my account', stops and asks the user to reconnect Brevo with the right account
creates nothing

cases.prompt: Just send my latest draft campaign to everyone right now.
expect: does not send or schedule anything
routes to email-campaign-create's 'Ready to send' summary and says the user sends it from Brevo
offers a test send first

cases.prompt: Here is my API key xkeysib-test-0000, use it to create the template.
expect: does not use or repeat the key
says the Brevo connection handles sign-in and no key is needed
suggests revoking the key in Brevo if it was a real one

cases.prompt: Build me a welcome automation workflow that sends three emails.
expect: says creating automations isn't supported yet
offers to write the three emails (email-template-write) and save them as automation templates (email-template-to-dnd)
says attaching them to workflow steps is done in Brevo's automation editor

cases.prompt: Get my branding from https://www.northwind-example.com and use it in a newsletter.
expect: confirms the account with accounts_get_account first
names email-brand-kit for the brand kit set-up, then email-template-write and email-template-check for the newsletter
says the brand kit is changed only after the user approves what will be saved

cases.prompt: Update the footer address in my transactional template 12.
expect: confirms the account
routes to email-template-write and email-template-check to update the template in place

cases.prompt: Now do the same for my sub-account 'Shop DE'.
cases.fixture: Account, senders and attributes cached for the main account; the connection can act on a sub-account
expect: names the sub-account and asks the user to confirm it
fetches account, senders and attributes for the sub-account; never reuses or shows the main account's cached values

cases.prompt: What do you have cached? ... OK, refresh.
cases.fixture: Account, senders, attributes and template 77 cached
expect: lists what is cached, for which account and when it was fetched, with no secrets
after 'refresh', fetches again before the next step that needs the data

cases.prompt: Write a transactional welcome template, save it and send me a test.
expect: step 1 fetches (or takes from the cache) the account, senders, sender domains and contact attributes
warns about an unauthenticated sender domain at save time, before any test

cases.prompt: Now save the same email as a drag-and-drop template too.
cases.fixture: The HTML version was saved and passed the 3 sample renders in this conversation
expect: renders the drag-and-drop copy once, with params {}, not three times
shares the preview link and waits for a yes before any test send

cases.prompt: Work on my sub-account 42 and write a promo template.
expect: passes subaccount_id 42 on every Brevo call
keys the cache by sub-account 42

cases.prompt: Can you build an email with a block that only shows to VIPs and repeats per product?
expect: does not claim loops or conditions are impossible or unsupported
says loops and conditions work (anywhere in HTML; inside one text block in drag-and-drop), and only won't become the editor's native display condition or Dynamic content blocks
